summary: Verified the new channel semaphore (Web / ML) on the Properties grid (/propiedades). Logged in as qa_varela@vera.test → landed on /hoy → navigated to /propiedades → clicked 'Todas'. All property cards render a [data-testid=property-channels] block containing [data-testid=property-channel-web] and [data-testid=property-channel-ml], each with a colored dot (.vera-dot--published/.vera-dot--error/.vera-dot--none). For the target property 9c1d4217-2522-4649-a269-bbd536a71f39 BOTH dots are GREEN — Web dot class = 'vera-dot vera-dot--published' and ML dot class = 'vera-dot vera-dot--published'. No console errors during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: PropertiesScreen.tsx ChannelSemaphore: mapping is defensive (publications?.['web-varela']?.status) and channelTone() collapses any non-'published'/'error' value (including missing) to grey ('none'). OK.
The semaphore is always rendered (even when publications map is absent), showing two grey dots. This is the desired 'at a glance' behavior — draft/unpublished properties correctly show grey. OK.

Minor a11y suggestion (not a bug): the dots are decorative spans without aria-label. Consider adding aria-label='Publicada en Web' / 'No publicada en Web' etc. on each channel span for screen readers. Not blocking.
